title: KMDS materials research data schema (for test)
description: simplied schema to check the schema validity

data name.description: name of the data set, named by data provider; This is your own unique data or specimen identifier. With this text string alone, you should be able to identify the materials (system) in your own internal data management system.
data name.example: Zinc coated Fe-6Mn-3Al steel plate; Ti/Al dissimilar welded joint; Fe/C catalyst; Gd doped MOF 370; LLZO (Li7La3Zr2O12) Solid Electrolyte; Low Carbon TRIP Steel; 0.15C1.0Si1.5Mn1.5Al; Co single atom catalyst; Pt50Co50/TiO2; Material_1/Material_2/Material_3/Material_4;

data classification.description: classification code for relevant fields of science and technology announced by Ministry of Science and ICT of KOREA (https://www.law.go.kr)

data generation date.description: date when the data is added to the present database or data lake

data source.description: source information of the data, such as lab log, source publication, related projects, DOI of data, lead author, and publication date if the data is extracted from a publication; The DOI number referring to the published paper or dataset where the data can be found. If the data is unpublished, enter “Unpublished”; lead author is the surname of the first author. If several authors, end with et al. If the DOI number is given correctly, this will be extracted automatically from www.crossref.org ; publication date will be extracted automatically from www.crossref.org if the DOI number is given correctly.
data source.example: extracted from Acta Mater vol 13, page 2089 (2000); archived on 01/01/2021; 10.1016/j.actamat.2016.08.081; generated in CNMD, POSTECH (2021)

name.description: contibutor's name in the form of "[last name], [first name]"

affiliation.description: contibutor's affliation (insitute's name and further description of working place)
affiliation.example: Advanced Materials Research Center, KIST; Department of Energy, KAIST; Metallurgy Division, KIMS

researcher number.description: contributor’s researcher number ID in Integrated R&D Information System of Korea (https://iris.go.kr); only applied for Korean researchers

keywords.description: keywords representing the data set or material type and description, at least 3 keywords should be provided

embargo.description: date when allowing open access of the data

materials.description: inherent data of material that composed of the material system; this is array of n materials defined by the material_id

id.decription: id of materials inside of the dataset, that is to be used for defining materials system

name.description: description of materials according to customary usage, designation system, composition, supplier, brand name, polymer name based on IUPAC recommendation (https://iupac.org/polymer-edu/polymer-naming/), etc.
name.example: annealed INCONEL625 plate; Al7075-T6; Al10Si5Mg; Fe; CNT; TiO2; Ag; In2O2; LLZO; Aldrich CFO plate; poly(methyl methacrylate); poly[oxy(1-bromoethane-1,2-diyl)]; polypropylene; $$$ Toray T300; $$$ Owens Corning E-glass; $$$ Hyosung Carbon Fiber; Kukdo Epoxy $$$!@#; Hyosung Nylon $$$!@#; polyimide $$$!@#

chemical information.description: atomic scale information of material; *** 폴리머 데이터 추가하면서 대폭 수정

constituent.description: name of constituent such as element symbol, molecular fomula, molecule name, etc

concentration.description: concentration of the element in material

unit.description: unit of the composition value in at.% or wt.%

structure.description: structural information of materials in all scales; crystallographic, micro, meso and macro scales

property.description: attribute, quality, or chracteristic of materials

electrical property.description: physical properties that a material exhibits upon the application of electric forces

dielectric constant.description: relative premittivity compared to the vacuum in induced polarization stored in a material under electric field.

system.title: System
system.description: data of material system associated to a specific application; "note" is for general description of the materials system, "configuration" includes the information of system composition in terms of the materials existing in the materials section. It also has "process" data to build the materials system. Finally, "performance" data is the performance of the material for the specific application.

oneOf.title: Catalyst
oneOf.$comment: system composed of catalyst active particle with support, sometimes with promotors

note.description: description of the system such as major research theme or application
note.example: LIB made in UNIST Prof. Seo's lab today

configuration.description: configurational information of the catalyst system

active material.description: materials ID (variable name) of active material in the catalyst system

amount of active material.description: amount of active materials in the catlyst system

coating material.description: materials ID (variable name) of coating material in the catalyst system

amount of coating material.description: amount of coating materials in the catalyst system

promotor.description: addictive materials which improves the catalyst performance

amount of promotor.description: amount of promotor added in the catlyst system

support materials.description: materials ID (variable name) of support in the catalyst system

temperature.description: temperature at which conversion rate is measured

equilibrium constant.description: The ratio of products to reactants when a chemical reaction approaches to equilibrium

oneOf.title: Piezoelectric
oneOf.$comment: system composed of piezoelectric layer alone

note.description: description of the system such as major research theme or application
note.example: energy havester made in SKKU Prof. Kim's lab 22-09-19

configuration.description: configurational information of a piezoelectric device

material.description: material name of the piezoelectric layer

performance.description: performance data of the piezoelectric device

maximum output current.description: measured maximum output current when applying the load to the piezoelectric device

value.description: value of the maximum output current

applied load.description: applied load to measure piezoelectric performance of device

load type.description: type of the applied load with corresponding data unit

load resistance.description: loaded resistance across the device to measure voltage

oneOf.title: Porous materials
oneOf.$comment: Information about the gas adsorption property of a porous material system

note.description: description of the system such as major research theme or application

configuration.description: configurational information of the porous materials system

grafted molecule.description: Chemically or physically grafted molecule inside the pore of porous material

grafted molecule amount.description: Loading amount of grafted molecule inside the pore of porous material

process.description: process to build the materials system

(process_n).description: information of nth process, sequentially stored in array
(process_n).type: corresponding data module of the process

performance.description: Performance of the gas adsorption behavior of porous materials system

enthalpy.description: Binding enthalpy of adsorbed gas molecules

temperature.description: temperature at which adsorption capacity is measured

pressure.description: pressure at which adsorption capacity is measured

SEM.description: Method for analyzing morphology of specimen using scanning electron beam

instrument.description: instrument that was used during measurement
instrument.example: Nova SEM; Inspect F; Inspect F50; Teneo VS; E-SEM; Regulus 8230

acceleration voltage.description: Acceleration voltage of electron beam generation

magnification.description: Ratio between scan area and display size

pixel size.description: Physical dimension represented by a single pixel %%%

field of view.description: Total observable area in the horizontal direction of the image, calculated as the product of pixel size and the number of pixels in the horizontal direction %%%

working distance.description: distance between the specimen and the lower pole piece

raw data.description: URI of data obtained duringmeasurement and analysis

SIMS.description: Method for  analyzing the composition of solid surfaces using SIMS to characterize the mass to charge ratio

instrument.description: instrument that was used during measurement
instrument.example: Magnetic sector SIMS; ToF-SIMS; Quadrupole SIMS

primary ion.example: Bi+; Cs+; Ga+; O2+; O-; Ar cluster ions

beam current.description: Current of the primary ion beam

flood gun.description: Used when charging occurs on the sample surface for ToF-SIMS

E-gun.description: Used when charging occurs on the sample surface for D-SIMS

sample voltage.description: Applied voltages at sample position for D-SIMS

raw data.description: URI of data obtained duringmeasurement and analysis

X-ray diffraction.description: Method for analyzing crystalline material using X-ray to characterize the phase, cyrstallinity and crystalline size etc. %%%

instrument.description: instrument that was used during measurement
instrument.example: PANalycal Empyrean; PANalycal X'pert Pro; Bruker D8 Advance; Bruker D8 Discover; Rigaku ATX-G; Rigaku Dmax2500

specimen form.description: The form of the sample used in the measurement &&&
specimen form.alias: type of samples, type of specimen

full width at half maximum.description: the width of an X-ray diffraction peak measured at half of its maximum intensity &&& %%%### 측정의 결과이지 측정의 조건은 아님.

x-ray source.description: X-ray source used in the XRD measurement

x-ray wavelength.description: Wavelength of characteristic X-ray used in measurement

incident angle.description: Incident beam angle when the beam incidence was fixed

offset angle.description: Angle of offset from symmetric theta-2theta configuration

2theta range.description: Data acquistion range in case of theta-2theta and 2theta scan.

scan rate.description: How fast X-ray diffraction data collection has been done. The data can be presented with two units; deg/min or sec/step

sample rotation.description: Rotating speed when the sample is rotated

raw data.description: URI of data obtained duringmeasurement and analysis

process.description:
material processes composed of sequence of not only synthesis but all post processing steps.  
• The sequence of the process is aligned with experimental procedure for the material preparation
• If the procedure for a material unknown, state that as: ‘Unknown’
• If a material is bought commercially and you do not know the process to prepare the material, indicate this by the label “Commercial”

extrusion.description: manufacturing process where solid polymer pellets or granules are heated until molten and then pushed through a die to form continuous shapes ***

materials type.description: type of materials to be processed

material feed rate.description: the rate at which polymer pellets or granules are fed into the extruder

temperature profile.description: temperature settings along different sections of the extruder

line speed.description: the speed at which the extruded material is pulled away from the die

pressure.description: pressure applied within the extruder at the metering section

residence time.description: time the polymer spends in the extruder

cooling method.description: method used to cool and solidify the extrudate after leaving the die

mixing.description: mixing two or more materials to make them homogenous

equipment.eng_def: conventional name of model name of the mixing equipment

material.description: name of materials such as material ID, molecular fomula, molecule name, etc

rotation speed.description: number of revolution per unit time for mixing process

atmosphere.description: process environment within the mixing chamber &&&

multilayer.description: common schema of mulilayer; described in general by the "repeating unit" composed of chemically homogeneous layers and the "number of repeating unit".

number of repeating unit.description: number of repeating unit of multilayer

materials.description: material id (in the materials section of this schema), element name or chemical nomenclature of the layer in the repeating unit

thickness.description: thickness of the layer in the repeating unit

orientation.description: orientation of the layer in the case of single crystal layer

direction.description: A direction in a plane vector form (e.g [hkl]) toward which the substrate offset is imposed
